violation_type.title: Field Trips - Written List of Children (26 TAC §747.2901(a)(3))
violation_type.short_title: Field Trips - Written List of Children
violation_type.typical_finding: Director did not have a list of the children he had during the field trip to park that is located across the street.      Note:  Corrected at inspection when director created the list of the children.

finding_variants.text: Director did not have a list of the children he had during the field trip to park that is located across the street.      Note:  Corrected at inspection when director created the list of the children.
The operation does not use a written list of children's names and information during field trips.
While attending a field trip the operation did not have a list of children on the field trip and was not able to do periodic checks.
